said: What classes do I have?
must: Lists his sections with course id and block, nothing else
proof: Matches classroom_sections where he is teacher of record
q: select label, block from public.classroom_sections where teacher_email = '<his email>' order by label

said: Who's in 209H Block 2?
must: The roster, first and last names
q: select e.display_name from public.classroom_enrollments e join public.classroom_sections s on s.id = e.section_id where s.label = 'Block 2' and s.teacher_email = '<his email>' and e.active order by 1

said: Find Mateo
must: One student with class, or candidates if more than one
q: select e.display_name, s.label from public.classroom_enrollments e join public.classroom_sections s on s.id = e.section_id where s.teacher_email = '<his email>' and e.display_name ilike '%Mateo%'

said: Give Mateo in Block 2 five coins for helping clean the shop
must: One award, amount 5, reason "helping clean the shop", logged by him
proof: coin_transactions row: his email as actor, 5, that reason; one connector_audit row
q: select amount, note, actor_email from public.coin_transactions where note = 'helping clean the shop' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Fine Daniel R three coins, phone out
must: One fine, 3, reason "phone out"
q: select amount, note, actor_email from public.coin_transactions where note = 'phone out' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Do that again
must: Asks whether he means a second fine; writes nothing until he says yes
proof: No new row before yes; one after
q: select count(*) from public.coin_transactions where note = 'phone out' and created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'

said: How many coins does Mateo have?
must: The digital balance
q: select public._coin_balance('<Mateo''s address>')

said: Undo that fine
must: The reversal row
proof: coin_transactions reversal linked to the fine; audit row
q: select amount, meta ->> 'reverses' from public.coin_transactions where category_id = 'reversal' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Give everyone in Block 1 two coins for the clean benches
must: One award per enrolled student, same reason
proof: One row per roster member, none for anyone else
q: select count(*) from public.coin_transactions where note = 'the clean benches' and created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'

said: Award the Shop Fix winners, Mateo and Leo, ten each
must: Two awards
q: select student_email, amount from public.coin_transactions where created_at > now() - interval '1 hour' and amount = 10 order by created_at desc limit 2

said: Set Mateo's balance to zero
must: Previews the adjustment and asks; nothing written until yes
q: select amount, note from public.coin_transactions where category_id = 'balance_correction' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: What's the fine for a phone?
must: Reads the coin setting
q: select amount from public.coin_categories where id = 'off_task_device_use'

said: Change the phone fine to four
must: Asks first
q: select key, new_value from public.coin_settings_audit order by changed_at desc limit 1

said: What's posted in 209H Block 1?
must: Items with title, kind, due, published state
q: select i.title, i.kind, i.due_at, i.published from public.classroom_items i join public.classroom_postings p on p.item_id = i.id join public.classroom_sections s on s.id = p.section_id where s.label = 'Block 1' order by i.created_at desc

said: What's due this week in IDEA100?
must: Items due in the current week, LA time
proof: The listed items' due dates fall in this school week
q: select title, due_at from public.classroom_items where due_at between date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'America/Los_Angeles') and date_trunc('week', now() at time zone 'America/Los_Angeles') + interval '7 days'

said: Post an announcement to all 209H sections: bring safety glasses tomorrow
must: One quick post to every 209H section
proof: classroom_quick_posts row per section, his email
q: select q.body, count(qs.section_id) from public.classroom_quick_posts q join public.classroom_quick_post_sections qs on qs.post_id = q.id group by q.id, q.body order by max(q.created_at) desc limit 1

said: Create an assignment in Block 2 called Tolerance Check, 20 points, due Friday at 11:59
must: One item, 20 points, due resolved to the coming Friday 23:59 LA
q: select title, points, due_at at time zone 'America/Los_Angeles' from public.classroom_items where title = 'Tolerance Check' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Make it worth 25
must: Points changed on the item just made
q: select points from public.classroom_items where title = 'Tolerance Check' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Move the due date to Monday
must: Due changed
q: select due_at at time zone 'America/Los_Angeles' from public.classroom_items where title = 'Tolerance Check' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Unpublish it
must: Published false
q: select published from public.classroom_items where title = 'Tolerance Check' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Publish it
must: Published true
q: select published from public.classroom_items where title = 'Tolerance Check' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Pin the syllabus post in Block 4
must: Pinned
q: select title, pinned from public.classroom_items where title ilike '%syllabus%' order by created_at desc

said: Set the rubric on Tolerance Check: Accuracy 10, Drawing 10, Reflection 5
must: A three-criterion rubric
q: select jsonb_array_length(r.criteria) from public.classroom_rubrics r join public.classroom_items i on i.id = r.item_id where i.title = 'Tolerance Check' order by i.created_at desc limit 1

said: Replace the Shop Fix HTML in Block 1 with the file I'm sending
must: Refuses if any answered block id would vanish, naming them; otherwise replaces and reports the block diff
proof: classroom_html_assignments revision; or no change and the refusal names the ids
q: select tool, outcome from public.connector_requests where tool = 'replace_html_assignment' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Show me the block diff before you replace it
must: Preview only, nothing written
q: select outcome from public.connector_requests where tool = 'replace_html_assignment' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Who hasn't turned in Shop Fix in Block 2?
must: Names with no submission
q: select e.display_name from public.classroom_enrollments e join public.classroom_sections s on s.id = e.section_id where s.label = 'Block 2' and e.active

said: What did Mateo answer on question 3 of the DFM worksheet?
must: His stored answer for that block
q: select block_id, value from public.classroom_responses where student_email = '<Mateo''s address>' order by updated_at desc limit 5

said: Grade Mateo's Shop Fix 18 out of 20, comment "fix the fillet callout"
must: One grade with that comment
q: select direct_score, teacher_comment, graded_by from public.classroom_submissions where teacher_comment = 'fix the fillet callout' order by graded_at desc limit 1

said: Give Leo a perfect score on the trophy reflection
must: Grade at full points; the Perfect Score coin hook fires as it would by hand
proof: Grade row and the system coin row
q: select category_id, amount, actor_email from public.coin_transactions where category_id = 'perfect_score_graded_work' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Send Mateo feedback on his notebook: cite the datasheet next time
must: One feedback row
q: select body from public.classroom_feedback_messages where body ilike '%datasheet%' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Mark all of Block 1's Shop Fix feedback as seen
must: Asks first, because it is a bulk stamp nothing can clear; marks every note seen after yes
q: select count(*) from public.classroom_feedback_threads where teacher_seen_at > now() - interval '1 hour'

said: Delete the duplicate Tolerance Check post
must: Previews, asks; deletes only after yes
proof: Item gone only after yes; audit row
q: select count(*) from public.classroom_items where title = 'Tolerance Check'

said: Remove Daniel from Block 2
must: Asks first
q: select student_email from public.classroom_enrollments e join public.classroom_sections s on s.id = e.section_id where s.label = 'Block 2' and e.display_name ilike '%Daniel%'

said: Close the Shop Fix assignment in Block 4
must: Closed
q: select state, count(*) from public.classroom_submissions s join public.classroom_items i on i.id = s.item_id where i.title = 'Shop Fix' group by state

said: Open Mateo's submission so he can resubmit
must: Reopened
q: select state from public.classroom_submissions where student_email = '<Mateo''s address>' order by updated_at desc limit 1

said: Set up a tournament called Blade Night with the Block 2 teams
must: Tournament created and seeded; no match advanced
q: select t.name, count(e.id), (select count(*) from public.tournament_match_events m where m.tournament_id = t.id) from public.tournaments t left join public.tournament_entries e on e.tournament_id = t.id where t.name = 'Blade Night' group by t.id, t.name

said: Advance the first match
must: Refuses: live operation is manual, with the link to the tournament page
q: select count(*) from public.tournament_match_events where created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'

said: What's in the Foundry review queue?
must: The queue
q: select a.title, v.status from public.student_app_versions v join public.student_apps a on a.id = v.app_id where v.status = 'submitted'

said: Approve the first one
must: Asks first, because a review is given once; approved after yes
proof: The version is approved only after yes
q: select status, reviewed_at from public.student_app_versions order by reviewed_at desc nulls last limit 1

said: Purge that Armory project
must: Asks first
proof: Nothing until yes; the route's audit row appears only after yes
q: select tool, status, finished_at from public.connector_audit where tool = 'delete_project_forever' order by started_at desc limit 1

said: Fine Daniel two coins for being late
must: Two Daniels in his classes: asks which, writes nothing
q: select count(*) from public.coin_transactions where note = 'being late' and created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'

said: The one in Block 4
must: The fine lands on that Daniel
q: select student_email, amount from public.coin_transactions where note = 'being late' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Give Alex five coins
must: No Alex on any roster: says so, writes nothing
q: select count(*) from public.coin_transactions where created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'

said: Award ten coins to Block 7
must: No Block 7: says so
q: select count(*) from public.coin_transactions where created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'

said: Give Mateo a hundred coins
must: Writes it (his account can) and reads back the amount
q: select amount from public.coin_transactions where amount = 100 order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Issue the SolidWorks Level 1 certification to Leo
must: Asks first (signed public record)
q: select serial, awarded_at from public.cert_awards order by awarded_at desc limit 1

said: How did the hall pass go in Block 2 today?
must: Passes and durations
q: select student_email, opened_at, closed_at from public.classroom_hall_passes where opened_at > now() - interval '1 day' order by opened_at

said: Open a hall pass for Mateo
must: Pass opened
q: select student_email, opened_at, closed_at from public.classroom_hall_passes order by opened_at desc limit 1

said: Turn the connector off
must: Asks, then every later call answers 401 until it is switched on at /admin/connector
q: select enabled, updated_by from public.connector_settings

said: Disconnect this phone
must: Asks, revokes this token
q: select label, revoked_at from public.connector_tokens order by revoked_at desc nulls last limit 1

said: Add twenty coins to Mateo's balance
must: Runs at once: an increase needs no confirmation (Mr. Pina, 2026-10-17)
proof: coin_transactions row of +20 via the balance adjustment; audit row
q: select amount, category_id from public.coin_transactions where category_id = 'balance_correction' order by created_at desc limit 1

said: Make a seating chart for Block 2
must: No site function does this: says so plainly, calls report_gap, writes nothing else
proof: connector_gaps row with his words, status open
q: select said, status from public.connector_gaps order by created_at desc limit 1
